name: To Valanaar
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers I have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.
narrative.requestItemsText: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
